+- [ ] Delete `Sources/AgentViewKitFoundationModels/` and `Tests/AgentViewKitFoundationModelsTests/`.

+
+## Acceptance Criteria
+- [ ] No file in `Sources/`, `Tests/` or `Examples/ReadmeSnippets/` imports `FoundationModels` or `AgentViewKitFoundationModels`.
+- [ ] `swift build --build-tests` and `swift test` pass. `Scripts/check-readme.sh` passes.
+
+## Tests
+- [ ] `Tests/PackageStructureTests/ManifestTests.swift`: change the expected product list to `AgentViewKit` and `AgentViewKitACP`.
+- [ ] `Tests/PackageStructureTests/ImportBoundaryTests.swift`: add the rule that no target in `Sources/` imports `FoundationModels`.
+- [ ] `swift test` passes.
+
+## Workflow
+- Use `/tdd` — write failing tests first, then implement to make them pass.
